claim: A creator (Jaz Hand Made) and friends trying combos that supposedly taste like other foods went viral; search summary dates it to late September 2026
excerpt: In just a few weeks, the video has racked up nearly 2 million views on TikTok, as well as receiving tens of thousands of likes.
title: 'My Brain Is Baffled': Group Of Girls Trying Weird Food Combinations That Trick Your Brain Goes Viral
